titulo: Prospecting and combined offer: from teaching to ongoing support
lead: Selling website building has become a price fight. What sells well is a ladder: teach, diagnose, support, and review, all the way to the monthly report. Prospecting changes too: you show up with a public finding about the person's site, not a package. And your own site, measured honestly, is the best proof.
objetivo: build the offer ladder (teaching → diagnosis → plan → ongoing support) and a list of 10 prospects with the reason for each contact.

aprende.t: The four roles of the Professional 2030 applied to SEO
The combined offer: SEO, AI, and agent readiness
Prospecting with a public finding, gate, and opt-out
The dated plan to complete the whole course

hero_alt: A consultant walks down a neighborhood shopping street lined with small shops, holding a tablet.

nos.detalhe: A short workshop: how Google, Bing, and AIs find a site, and what the non-branded number is. It shows the method, not a tool. It's the front door.
The diagnosis of a page (lesson 2), the 30/90/180 plan (lesson 3), and the proposal with limits (lesson 4).
Support the client's team while the foundation and the first pages go out: gates, review, teaching. In the end, the team can read the report on their own.
Review what the team has already done with AI: batch pages, bots blocked by mistake, spam tactics inherited from another vendor. Read-only, in writing, and not a pentest.
A one-page report, a question set run on the AIs, one decision per month (lesson 6). It's what keeps the relationship going.

secoes.legenda: Order of the Professional 2030 roles. The client can enter at any step; the monthly is where trust builds up.

texto: One diagnostic covers it all: what search engines see, the question set run on the AIs, and readiness for agents. A new site, when you need one, comes in as part of the plan, not as the product.
WebMCP is preparation: a W3C community draft (document.modelContext), with no stable browser. It is not a ranking factor.
Well-reviewed businesses whose site has a problem you can see from the outside: a page with no text in the HTML, mixed canonicals, search bots blocked.
Write down the finding and the URL. It's the reason for reaching out, and it's already a sample of the diagnostic.

exemplo.texto: INEMA's open pipeline runs from discovered → qualified → … → gate → sent, with opt-out, a suppression list and one contact per lead. Use its discipline; swap the site redesign for the diagnostic.

texto: One message: the finding, why it matters, and the offer to show the diagnostic. No promise of rankings, with an option to stop receiving messages.
One contact per prospect. If there's no reply, don't push with an automatic sequence.
Apply the method to your own site and publish the before and after, including what didn't work.
INEMA tells its own zero: 0 of 52 AI measurements in July, non-branded impressions from 8 to 157, non-branded clicks still at 0 on the club. That convinces more than a testimonial.

secoes.sub: The explanation appears after your answer.

perguntas.p: A prospect wants just "a new site." How do you fit that into your offer?
opcoes: Sell only the site, cheaper than the competition.
As part of the plan that comes out of the diagnostic, with measurement and follow-up; the product is trust, not the build.
perguntas.explica: Building got easy and turned into a price fight. What sustains the relationship is diagnostics, follow-up and teaching.

perguntas.p: What goes into the first contact with a prospect?
opcoes: A public finding about their site, why it matters, the offer to show the diagnostic, and the option to stop receiving messages.
perguntas.explica: The finding shows method before selling. Opt-out and one contact per prospect show respect and keep you from becoming spam.

perguntas.p: The client asks whether WebMCP will put their site at the top of the AIs. What do you say?
opcoes: That it's a W3C draft with no stable browser support; it counts as preparation for agents, not as a ranking factor.
That it's already a standard in every browser.
That it's the same as llms.txt.
perguntas.explica: Selling preparation as a result is the same empty promise as a guaranteed ranking.

perguntas.p: Why publish the case of your own site, including the zero?
opcoes: Because a real number with a source, even a bad one, proves the method better than a testimonial.
perguntas.explica: INEMA shows 0 of 52 in the AIs and 0 non-branded clicks on the club. That's what makes the other numbers believable.
